rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact new recurrence-control path instead of another scalar sweep. The added tail_anchor_gates let each recurrent tail block refresh its anchor toward the newly updated hidden state, turning the fixed decoder-output anchor into a learned EMA-style anchor during reverse recurrence. This keeps shapes and compile behavior stable, stays cheap in bytes, preserves the existing quant-aware/export path, and directly targets the strong local motif around reverse-tail anchor variants.
title: Reverse-Tail EMA Anchor Refresh
